name: secure-recorder
description: Expo module for secure audio recording with streaming AES-256-GCM encryption

scripts.validate: echo '✅ Module structure' && test -f package.json && test -f expo-module.config.json && test -f android/build.gradle && test -f ios/SecureRecorderModule.swift && test -f src/index.ts && echo '✅ All required files present'
scripts.verify: pnpm run clean && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run validate && pnpm run verify:android && pnpm run verify:ios
scripts.build:ios: cd ../../ios && xcodebuild build -workspace TiroScribe.xcworkspace -scheme TiroScribe -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 15'
scripts.test:unit: pnpm run test:android && pnpm run test:ios
scripts.test:ios: cd ../../ios && xcodebuild test -workspace TiroScribe.xcworkspace -scheme TiroScribe -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 15' -only-testing:TiroScribeTests

author: Tiro Scribe
